description: Data Agro Limited is a public limited company, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, that makes and sells hybrid seed. It began in 1992 selling seed as a small company and now runs its own research and development department, which it states uses patented methods and high-quality seed stock to develop its varieties.
